focus: 用鹽質量分層動力與排水限制評估河口阻鹽策略~Evaluate estuary salt control with mass balance, stratification and drainage constraints

units.anchor: 完全混合與鹽收支~Complete mixing and salt balance
units.title: 完全混合與鹽收支~Complete mixing and salt balance
units.mechanism: 淡鹹水混合首先要統一鹽的表示方式，質量濃度與實用鹽度或電導不是可任意互換的數字。穩態完全混合模型以入流鹽質量守恆求出口濃度，但真實河口常有底層鹽楔及潮汐逆流；平均濃度不能描述取水口所在深度的短時暴露。 假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。 ~Mixing calculations require a consistent salt measure: mass concentration, practical salinity and conductance are not interchangeable numbers. A steady completely mixed balance equates incoming and outgoing salt mass, whereas real estuaries may contain a bottom wedge and reversing tides. Mean concentration therefore cannot describe short-term exposure at a particular intake depth or establish a spatial intrusion boundary by itself. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³.
units.verify: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。用多深度剖面檢查分層，將平均收支和取水口暴露分開，不把結果直接改寫為鹽楔長度。~Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Test stratification with profiles and separate the average balance from intake exposure rather than converting the calculated concentration directly into a salt-wedge intrusion distance.
units.failure: 僅量表層可能漏掉底部高鹽入侵，將電導數字當質量濃度又使守恆量綱失真。即使整體平均降低，局部取水點仍可能遇到短暫高濃度水團。~Surface-only sampling misses saline bottom intrusion, while substituting conductance for mass concentration breaks the balance dimensions. Even a falling system mean can coexist with a brief high-concentration water mass reaching a particular intake.
units.misconception: 河口平均鹽濃度下降就證明所有深度與取水位置都同樣改善。~Lower mean estuary concentration proves an equal improvement at every depth and intake.
units.practice: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。用多深度剖面檢查分層，將平均收支和取水口暴露分開，不把結果直接改寫為鹽楔長度。~Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Test stratification with profiles and separate the average balance from intake exposure rather than converting the calculated concentration directly into a salt-wedge intrusion distance.

units.title: 斷面鹽通量~Section salt transport
units.mechanism: 鹽通量是流速與濃度在斷面的共同積分，漲退潮方向和分層會讓兩者呈現相關性。平均濃度乘淨流量只適用均勻或明定近似，零淨水量也可能有非零淨鹽輸送；因此要同時觀測水流與鹽分，不能只靠一支鹽度儀解讀入侵。 假設截面均勻且向陸流量20m³/s、鹽質量濃度15kg/m³，向陸鹽通量QC=300kg/s；實際分層需積分uC。 ~Salt flux integrates velocity times concentration across a section. Tidal direction and stratification correlate these variables, so mean concentration times net discharge is valid only under a stated approximation. Zero net water exchange can still produce net salt transport. Simultaneous flow and concentration observations are therefore essential; one salinity sensor cannot independently reveal the full direction or magnitude of intrusion. Assume uniform landward flow20m³/s and salt concentration15kg/m³. Landward flux QC=300kg/s; stratified flow requires section integration of uC.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設截面均勻且向陸流量20m³/s、鹽質量濃度15kg/m³，向陸鹽通量QC=300kg/s；實際分層需積分uC。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform landward flow20m³/s and salt concentration15kg/m³. Landward flux QC=300kg/s; stratified flow requires section integration of uC.
units.verify: 將斷面分層量測流速和濃度，保留流向符號與潮相，逐格積分後再做週期平均。比較平均乘積與乘積平均的差異，標示未量區和外推方式，不以淨流量代替雙向交換。~Measure velocity and concentration by section cell with direction and tidal phase, integrating before cycle averaging. Compare product-of-means with mean-product results, documenting unmeasured areas and extrapolation instead of replacing two-way exchange by net water flow alone.
units.failure: 底層入侵與表層出流可在水量上相抵，若只看淨流量會誤以為沒有鹽輸入。濃度採樣和流速時鐘不一致，亦會把高潮高鹽錯配到退潮出流。~Bottom inflow and surface outflow can cancel volumetrically, making net-discharge records falsely suggest no salt input. Unsynchronized concentration and velocity can also pair high-tide salinity with an unrelated ebb flow and reverse the inferred transport.
units.misconception: 一個潮週期淨水量為零就代表淨鹽輸送量必定為零。~Zero net water volume over a tide necessarily means zero net salt transport.
units.practice: 將斷面分層量測流速和濃度，保留流向符號與潮相，逐格積分後再做週期平均。比較平均乘積與乘積平均的差異，標示未量區和外推方式，不以淨流量代替雙向交換。~Measure velocity and concentration by section cell with direction and tidal phase, integrating before cycle averaging. Compare product-of-means with mean-product results, documenting unmeasured areas and extrapolation instead of replacing two-way exchange by net water flow alone.

units.anchor: 鹽庫存與變化率~Salt storage and change rate
units.title: 鹽庫存與變化率~Salt storage and change rate
units.mechanism: 控制體內鹽庫存等於體積乘平均質量濃度，但當濃度和水量都變動時需完整微分。固定容積完全混合箱可由入出鹽通量算瞬時濃度變率，之後出口濃度也跟著變化；不能把初始變率長時間線性外推，或將觀測殘差全部歸為感測錯誤。 假設固定V=1000000m³、箱內C=2kg/m³，入出流各100m³/s、入流C=5，庫存2000000kg，瞬時dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s)。 ~Salt storage is volume times mean mass concentration, requiring a full derivative if both change. A constant-volume mixed box converts net salt flux into an instantaneous concentration rate, but outlet concentration then evolves with the box. The initial rate cannot be extrapolated linearly indefinitely, and unexplained residuals may represent omitted pathways or mixing structure rather than only sensor error. Assume fixed volume1000000m³,box concentration2kg/m³,equal flows100m³/s and input5kg/m³. Storage=2000000kg; instantaneous dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s).
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設固定V=1000000m³、箱內C=2kg/m³，入出流各100m³/s、入流C=5，庫存2000000kg，瞬時dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s)。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume fixed volume1000000m³,box concentration2kg/m³,equal flows100m³/s and input5kg/m³. Storage=2000000kg; instantaneous dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s).
units.verify: 將容積變化與鹽濃度變化分開核對，確認進出流是否真的平衡，按每個時間步更新出口濃度。以獨立剖面估庫存，保存未閉合收支並調查漏掉的側支流、底層或地下水交換。~Check volume and concentration changes separately and verify equal inflow-outflow before updating outlet concentration at every timestep. Estimate storage independently from profiles, retaining residuals while investigating missing tributaries, lower-layer exchange or groundwater rather than forcing numerical closure.
units.failure: 忽略水位變化會把稀釋誤認為鹽移除，固定使用初始出口濃度又累積不守恆誤差。未量到底層高鹽庫存時，即使表層感測穩定也不能宣告整體庫存不變。~Ignoring changing volume confuses dilution with salt removal, while retaining initial outlet concentration accumulates nonconservative error. An unseen saline lower-layer reservoir can change even when surface sensors appear stable, invalidating a whole-estuary storage conclusion.
units.misconception: 初始濃度變化率可以無限制線性外推而不需更新出口鹽濃度。~The initial concentration-change rate can be extrapolated indefinitely without updating outlet concentration.
units.practice: 將容積變化與鹽濃度變化分開核對，確認進出流是否真的平衡，按每個時間步更新出口濃度。以獨立剖面估庫存，保存未閉合收支並調查漏掉的側支流、底層或地下水交換。~Check volume and concentration changes separately and verify equal inflow-outflow before updating outlet concentration at every timestep. Estimate storage independently from profiles, retaining residuals while investigating missing tributaries, lower-layer exchange or groundwater rather than forcing numerical closure.

units.anchor: 理想沖淡時間~Ideal flushing time
units.title: 理想沖淡時間~Ideal flushing time
units.mechanism: 沖淡速度取決於有效混合容積和交換路徑，完全混合箱會呈指數下降而不是每段時間去除固定鹽量。實際河口有死水區、再入侵和潮汐交換，單一停留尺度不能代表所有水團年齡；計算結果應是比較假設的基準，不是實際供水恢復時間保證。 假設完全混合固定V=1000000m³、淡水Q=100m³/s、無再入鹽，C由5降1kg/m³，t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h。 ~Flushing depends on effective mixing volume and exchange pathways. A completely mixed box declines exponentially rather than losing a fixed salt mass each interval. Dead zones, renewed intrusion and tidal exchange create multiple residence times in an estuary, so one scale does not describe every parcel age. The calculation compares assumptions rather than guaranteeing when an actual water supply will recover. Assume a fixed mixed box1000000m³,fresh inflow100m³/s and no renewed salt input. Falling5to1kg/m³ takes t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設完全混合固定V=1000000m³、淡水Q=100m³/s、無再入鹽，C由5降1kg/m³，t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a fixed mixed box1000000m³,fresh inflow100m³/s and no renewed salt input. Falling5to1kg/m³ takes t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h.
units.verify: 用時間序列檢查對數濃度是否近似線性，辨識淡水入口、出口與滯留區，核對有無潮汐再入。比較不同深度下降速率並報告模型殘差，不能用單點達標時間推定全部水體完成置換。~Check whether log concentration is approximately linear through time, locating inlet, outlet and stagnant zones and testing tidal re-entry. Compare decline at different depths and report residuals instead of using one sensor's threshold time to declare complete replacement of the water body.
units.failure: 快速表面通道可能讓出口很快變淡卻留下深層鹽水，後續混合又使濃度回升。若只用名義總容積和流量估時間，會漏掉這種短路與長尾行為。~A surface shortcut can freshen the outlet quickly while leaving deep saltwater that later remixes and raises concentration. Nominal total volume divided by flow misses this short-circuiting and long-tail behavior within the actual estuary.
units.misconception: 一個容積除流量的時間後所有原有鹽水都必定完全排出。~After one volume-divided-by-flow interval, every original parcel of saltwater has certainly left.
units.practice: 用時間序列檢查對數濃度是否近似線性，辨識淡水入口、出口與滯留區，核對有無潮汐再入。比較不同深度下降速率並報告模型殘差，不能用單點達標時間推定全部水體完成置換。~Check whether log concentration is approximately linear through time, locating inlet, outlet and stagnant zones and testing tidal re-entry. Compare decline at different depths and report residuals instead of using one sensor's threshold time to declare complete replacement of the water body.

units.anchor: 密度差與內波速度~Density contrast and internal waves
units.title: 密度差與內波速度~Density contrast and internal waves
units.mechanism: 淡鹹水密度差使界面能支持內波，其速度遠小於自由表面重力波且受上下層厚度控制。兩層淺水、剛蓋與小振幅模型只適合辨識尺度，不含剪切、摩擦及界面厚度；將它套到完全混合河段會失去物理意義，應先用量測確認垂向分層存在。 假設Δρ=20、參考ρ=1000kg/m³，g′=0.1962m/s²；兩層厚4與6m，c=√[g′h1h2/(h1+h2)]=0.6862m/s。 ~A density contrast supports internal waves with speeds much lower than free-surface waves and dependent on both layer thicknesses. A two-layer shallow-water rigid-lid small-amplitude model identifies a scale only, excluding shear, friction and finite interface thickness. Applying it to a well-mixed reach is physically inappropriate, so observed stratification must first justify the assumed two-layer representation. Assume density contrast20kg/m³,reference1000kg/m³,g′=0.1962m/s² and layers4and6m. Rigid-lid long-wave speed c=0.6862m/s.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Δρ=20、參考ρ=1000kg/m³，g′=0.1962m/s²；兩層厚4與6m，c=√[g′h1h2/(h1+h2)]=0.6862m/s。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume density contrast20kg/m³,reference1000kg/m³,g′=0.1962m/s² and layers4and6m. Rigid-lid long-wave speed c=0.6862m/s.
units.verify: 量測溫鹽密度剖面並確認界面和層厚，明列長波與剛蓋假設，核對背景剪切流。將界面移動時序與估計速度比較，保留界面模糊或完全混合的時段，不強行維持兩層參數。~Measure temperature-salinity density profiles to identify interface and layer depths, stating long-wave and rigid-lid assumptions and checking shear. Compare interface timing with the estimate, retaining blurred-interface or fully mixed periods rather than forcing a two-layer parameterization through all conditions.
units.failure: 表層鹽度低不代表底層密度差固定，風混合可使界面消失。若仍用相同內波速度預測鹽楔回應，會錯估通量調整與感測器間訊號延遲。~Low surface salinity does not imply a fixed density contrast below, and wind mixing can erase the interface. Retaining the same internal-wave speed then misstates transport adjustment and the expected lag between monitoring stations.
units.misconception: 內波速度與上下鹽水淡水層厚度無關只由重力決定。~Internal-wave speed is independent of layer depths and depends only on gravity.
units.practice: 量測溫鹽密度剖面並確認界面和層厚，明列長波與剛蓋假設，核對背景剪切流。將界面移動時序與估計速度比較，保留界面模糊或完全混合的時段，不強行維持兩層參數。~Measure temperature-salinity density profiles to identify interface and layer depths, stating long-wave and rigid-lid assumptions and checking shear. Compare interface timing with the estimate, retaining blurred-interface or fully mixed periods rather than forcing a two-layer parameterization through all conditions.

units.anchor: 分層與剪切競爭~Stratification versus shear
units.title: 分層與剪切競爭~Stratification versus shear
units.mechanism: 密度分層抵抗垂向混合，速度剪切提供擾動能量，體積理查森數可整理兩者量級。它不同於局部梯度理查森數，不能直接沿用理想線性穩定門檻，真實河口還有潮汐歷史及邊界混合；比值用來比較狀態，不是無紊流或零混合證明。 假設g′=0.1962m/s²、層尺度H=2m、速度差ΔU=0.50m/s，Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696；非局部穩定門檻。 ~Stratification resists vertical exchange while shear supplies disturbance energy. A bulk Richardson number organizes their scales but differs from a local gradient Richardson number, so an ideal linear-stability threshold cannot be transferred directly. Tidal history and boundary mixing also matter. The ratio compares states rather than proving that turbulence or salt mixing is absent from the river or estuary. Assume g′=0.1962m/s²,layer scale2m and velocity difference0.50m/s. Bulk Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696, not a local stability threshold.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設g′=0.1962m/s²、層尺度H=2m、速度差ΔU=0.50m/s，Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696；非局部穩定門檻。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume g′=0.1962m/s²,layer scale2m and velocity difference0.50m/s. Bulk Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696, not a local stability threshold.
units.verify: 說明厚度和速度差取自哪些深度，使用同步密度與流速剖面，分別計算整層與局部指標。比較湍動或混合觀測及潮相，記錄低解析度可能漏掉的薄剪切層，而非只報一個比值。~Define depths used for thickness and velocity difference from synchronized density and velocity profiles. Distinguish bulk and local indicators, comparing turbulence evidence and tide phase and documenting thin shear layers missed by coarse sampling instead of reporting only one ratio.
units.failure: 大尺度分層強仍可能在薄界面出現高剪切，採樣間距太大會把局部不穩定平均掉。將體積數值與梯度門檻比較，可能錯誤宣稱沒有混合或入侵交換。~Strong bulk stratification can coexist with intense shear in a thin interface, which coarse sampling averages away. Comparing the bulk number directly with a gradient threshold can therefore falsely declare that mixing or exchange relevant to intrusion is absent.
units.misconception: 體積理查森數大於某個固定數字就證明整個河口完全沒有紊流。~A bulk Richardson number above one fixed value proves that the entire estuary is turbulence-free.
units.practice: 說明厚度和速度差取自哪些深度，使用同步密度與流速剖面，分別計算整層與局部指標。比較湍動或混合觀測及潮相，記錄低解析度可能漏掉的薄剪切層，而非只報一個比值。~Define depths used for thickness and velocity difference from synchronized density and velocity profiles. Distinguish bulk and local indicators, comparing turbulence evidence and tide phase and documenting thin shear layers missed by coarse sampling instead of reporting only one ratio.

units.anchor: 潮交換與淨輸送~Tidal exchange versus net transport
units.title: 潮交換與淨輸送~Tidal exchange versus net transport
units.mechanism: 潮汐流量正負交替，大量水體可往返交換而淨水量很小，這與潮混合輸鹽是不同統計量。正弦半週積分提供單向交換體積，不能當淡水沖洗量或新水替換量；被送出的水可能下一潮返回，因此水團追蹤與濃度仍不可省略。 假設Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s、T=43200s，正半週交換V=QmaxT/π=6875494m³，整週淨水量0。 ~Tidal discharge alternates sign, allowing large gross exchange with small net volume. This is statistically distinct from tide-driven salt transport. Integrating one positive sinusoidal half-cycle gives one-way exchanged volume, not freshwater flushing or completely new water. Exported parcels may return on the next tide, so concentration and parcel tracking remain necessary for interpreting the effective exchange of salt. Assume Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s with T=43200s. Positive half-cycle volume QmaxT/π=6875494m³; full-cycle net volume is0.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s、T=43200s，正半週交換V=QmaxT/π=6875494m³，整週淨水量0。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Q=500sin(2πt/T)m³/s with T=43200s. Positive half-cycle volume QmaxT/π=6875494m³; full-cycle net volume is0.
units.verify: 保存完整潮週期流量與濃度，分別積分漲潮、退潮和淨值，核對週期端點。用水團或示蹤證據估返回比例，區分總交換與有效更新，不把大量往返流誤解為同量淡水供應。~Retain a full tidal record of discharge and concentration, integrating flood, ebb and net quantities with consistent endpoints. Estimate return fraction from parcel or tracer evidence, distinguishing gross exchange from renewal rather than interpreting large oscillatory flow as an equal freshwater supply.
units.failure: 只取半潮資料會把單向交換誤當淨流入，端點相位偏差也可製造假淨量。交換量很大但回流水比例高時，污染或鹽分的真正排出仍可能緩慢。~Using only half a tide mistakes one-way exchange for net inflow, and endpoint phase error creates a false residual. Even large exchange may remove salt or contaminants slowly when a high fraction of exported water returns.
units.misconception: 一個漲潮交換進來的水量全部等於系統獲得的新淡水量。~Every cubic metre entering on flood tide is a cubic metre of new freshwater supplied.
units.practice: 保存完整潮週期流量與濃度，分別積分漲潮、退潮和淨值，核對週期端點。用水團或示蹤證據估返回比例，區分總交換與有效更新，不把大量往返流誤解為同量淡水供應。~Retain a full tidal record of discharge and concentration, integrating flood, ebb and net quantities with consistent endpoints. Estimate return fraction from parcel or tracer evidence, distinguishing gross exchange from renewal rather than interpreting large oscillatory flow as an equal freshwater supply.

units.anchor: 選擇性排鹽效率~Selective salt-export efficiency
units.title: 選擇性排鹽效率~Selective salt-export efficiency
units.mechanism: 底層較鹹時，選擇性取排可在同樣水量中帶走更多鹽，但混入淡水、界面吸升和潮向會改變效果。鹽通量比較只是局部效率，不代表整個水系供水、排洪和生態都改善；設施造成的阻力與新的運轉限制必須放入同一評估。 假設同樣Q=10m³/s，底層C=20與混合水C=5kg/m³，排鹽200與50kg/s，局部比例4；不含回流和排水限制。 ~Preferential bottom withdrawal can export more salt per unit water where stratification persists, but freshwater entrainment, interface draw-up and tide alter effectiveness. Comparing salt flux is only a local efficiency measure, not proof of better water supply, drainage and ecology across the system. Added resistance and operational constraints must be assessed alongside the intended selective-export benefit. Assume equal withdrawal10m³/s from bottom concentration20 or mixed5kg/m³. Salt export is200versus50kg/s, ratio4, excluding return flow and drainage constraints.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同樣Q=10m³/s，底層C=20與混合水C=5kg/m³，排鹽200與50kg/s，局部比例4；不含回流和排水限制。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume equal withdrawal10m³/s from bottom concentration20 or mixed5kg/m³. Salt export is200versus50kg/s, ratio4, excluding return flow and drainage constraints.
units.verify: 同步量排口深度、流量及濃度，追蹤界面隨排水變化，核對淡水夾帶和海側回流。將排鹽量與上下游水位、排洪能力及生態指標並列，不能以單一高濃度排水作成功結論。~Measure withdrawal depth, discharge and concentration together, tracking interface response, freshwater entrainment and seaward return. Compare salt export with upstream-downstream levels, drainage capacity and ecological indicators rather than declaring success solely from a concentrated saline outflow at the outlet.
units.failure: 排量增加可能吸入較淡上層使選擇性下降，設施阻力又可能限制暴雨時排水。若只比較每立方米鹽量，會漏掉為排鹽付出的水位或供水代價。~Higher withdrawal can entrain fresh upper water and reduce selectivity, while added resistance constrains drainage during rainfall. Comparing only salt per cubic metre misses the water-level or supply costs incurred elsewhere in the managed system.
units.misconception: 排口鹽濃度提高就能證明整個河口工程在所有功能上都更好。~Higher outlet salinity proves that the entire estuary project improves every function.
units.practice: 同步量排口深度、流量及濃度，追蹤界面隨排水變化，核對淡水夾帶和海側回流。將排鹽量與上下游水位、排洪能力及生態指標並列，不能以單一高濃度排水作成功結論。~Measure withdrawal depth, discharge and concentration together, tracking interface response, freshwater entrainment and seaward return. Compare salt export with upstream-downstream levels, drainage capacity and ecological indicators rather than declaring success solely from a concentrated saline outflow at the outlet.

units.anchor: 阻鹽設施與排水損失~Salt-control structure and drainage loss
units.title: 阻鹽設施與排水損失~Salt-control structure and drainage loss
units.mechanism: 阻鹽門檻或選擇性通道會改變水力連通，減少鹽入侵的同時可能增加排水水頭損失。固定局部係數僅示意速度平方關係，實際流場會受密度、開口與泵站互制影響；因此設計與驗證不能把排鹽和防洪各自視為完全獨立的系統。 假設局部係數K=2、參考速度1.5m/s，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294m；是合成清水基準，非艾默伊登量測。 ~A sill or selective channel changes hydraulic connectivity and can add drainage loss while addressing salt intrusion. A fixed local coefficient illustrates velocity-squared behavior only; density, openings and pumping interact in the real flow. Design and verification therefore cannot treat salt control and flood drainage as fully independent systems whose local successes automatically combine into successful overall performance. Assume K=2 and reference speed1.5m/s. hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294m is a synthetic clear-water baseline, not an IJmuiden measurement.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設局部係數K=2、參考速度1.5m/s，hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294m；是合成清水基準，非艾默伊登量測。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume K=2 and reference speed1.5m/s. hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294m is a synthetic clear-water baseline, not an IJmuiden measurement.
units.verify: 量測設施兩側水位與流量曲線，核對不同密度分層及開口狀態，分離泵站能力與通道損失。與建前基準比較並保留不符合預測的情境，追查影響來源而非只調係數掩蓋。~Measure head-discharge behavior on both sides under different stratification and openings, separating pumping capability from channel loss. Compare the pre-construction baseline and retain cases that contradict predictions, investigating their causes instead of simply tuning a coefficient to hide the mismatch.
units.failure: 枯水排鹽測試成功不能代表暴雨排洪不受影響，新增阻力可能使上游水位更難下降。若只在單一流量驗證，非線性損失在較大流量時會被低估。~Successful low-flow salt-export testing does not prove unaffected storm drainage; added resistance can slow upstream drawdown. Verification at one discharge may also understate nonlinear losses when substantially larger volumes must pass through the same constrained opening.
units.misconception: 阻鹽工程只影響鹽分而絕不可能改變排水能力和上游水位。~A salt-control structure affects salinity only and can never alter drainage capacity or upstream levels.
units.practice: 量測設施兩側水位與流量曲線，核對不同密度分層及開口狀態，分離泵站能力與通道損失。與建前基準比較並保留不符合預測的情境，追查影響來源而非只調係數掩蓋。~Measure head-discharge behavior on both sides under different stratification and openings, separating pumping capability from channel loss. Compare the pre-construction baseline and retain cases that contradict predictions, investigating their causes instead of simply tuning a coefficient to hide the mismatch.

units.anchor: 感測校正與判斷~Sensor calibration and interpretation
units.title: 感測校正與判斷~Sensor calibration and interpretation
units.mechanism: 電導轉鹽分需要溫度補償及適用關係，儀器漂移、生物附著與不同離子組成會影響結果。兩個數值相減只能指出與參考的差，不能自動決定哪一支錯；校正、獨立採樣和不確定度應共同支持控制判斷，避免把單點偏差誤認為鹽楔突然移動。 假設同樣本換算質量濃度感測3.20kg/m³、可追溯參考3.00kg/m³，偏差+0.20kg/m³、相對+6.667%；不代表水體變鹹。 ~Conductance-to-salt conversion requires temperature compensation and an appropriate relationship; drift, fouling and different ionic composition affect the result. Comparing two readings identifies a discrepancy but does not automatically show which is wrong. Calibration, independent samples and uncertainty must jointly support decisions so a biased point measurement is not mistaken for sudden movement of the salt wedge. Assume the same sample gives converted3.20kg/m³ versus traceable reference3.00kg/m³. Bias is+0.20kg/m³ or+6.667%, not evidence of environmental salinization.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同樣本換算質量濃度感測3.20kg/m³、可追溯參考3.00kg/m³，偏差+0.20kg/m³、相對+6.667%；不代表水體變鹹。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume the same sample gives converted3.20kg/m³ versus traceable reference3.00kg/m³. Bias is+0.20kg/m³ or+6.667%, not evidence of environmental salinization.
units.verify: 使用覆蓋工作範圍的可追溯標準與獨立樣本，記錄溫度、清潔前後讀值及轉換關係。將校正偏差、隨機散布和空間差異分開，保留原始電導資料供回算而不是只存換算鹽值。~Use traceable standards spanning the working range and independent samples, recording temperature, cleaning effects and the conversion relationship. Separate calibration bias, random scatter and spatial differences, retaining original conductance values for reprocessing rather than storing only converted concentration outputs.
units.failure: 感測器附著造成緩慢漂移可能觸發不必要的控制反應，錯誤溫度補償又會產生日週期假訊號。若多支儀器共用同一錯誤校正，彼此吻合也無法證明真實正確。~Fouling drift may trigger unnecessary control responses, and incorrect temperature compensation creates false daily cycles. Several instruments sharing the same flawed calibration can agree with each other while all remain biased relative to the actual water condition.
units.misconception: 多支感測器讀值相同就能排除共同校正偏差和轉換錯誤。~Agreement among sensors rules out any shared calibration bias or conversion error.
units.practice: 使用覆蓋工作範圍的可追溯標準與獨立樣本，記錄溫度、清潔前後讀值及轉換關係。將校正偏差、隨機散布和空間差異分開，保留原始電導資料供回算而不是只存換算鹽值。~Use traceable standards spanning the working range and independent samples, recording temperature, cleaning effects and the conversion relationship. Separate calibration bias, random scatter and spatial differences, retaining original conductance values for reprocessing rather than storing only converted concentration outputs.

title: 河口鹽水入侵控制~Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries
summary: 用鹽質量分層動力與排水限制評估河口阻鹽策略。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。~Evaluate estuary salt control with mass balance, stratification and drainage constraints. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
history: 河口阻鹽不是單一擋牆問題，淡水流量、潮汐交換、分層與排水功能都會互相影響。一九九一年潮汐水理手冊提供方法背景，二〇一九年美國地質調查局電導章節則強調量測品質。二〇二三年密西西比河低水期間的水下門檻是延緩鹽楔的場址措施，不能改寫成永久消除入侵。艾默伊登主管機關於二〇二五年四月回報，前一年末進入測試的鹽壩對排水影響大於預期，正說明功能互制必須經實測查核。本課合成數據分別練習守恆、分層和損失，不把局部排鹽效率當成整體成效保證。~Estuary salt control is not simply a barrier problem: freshwater flow, tidal exchange, stratification and drainage interact. The1991 tidal manual supplies methodology, while USGS’s2019 conductance chapter emphasizes measurement quality. The2023 Mississippi sill is a site intervention to delay a salt wedge, not permanent elimination of intrusion. In April2025 the IJmuiden authority reported greater-than-expected drainage effects during testing that began late the previous year, demonstrating why coupled functions require observations. Synthetic examples separately examine conservation, stratification and losses; local salt-export efficiency is not presented as a guarantee of successful whole-system performance.
example: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。假設淡水流100增加10%至110m³/s，鹹流仍10m³/s且35kg/m³，混合濃度由3.1818降至350/120=2.9167kg/m³，下降8.333%；不直接表示鹽楔縮短同樣比例。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。~This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³. Increasing freshwater10% from100to110m³/s while saline input remains10m³/s at35kg/m³ lowers mixed concentration3.1818to2.9167kg/m³, a8.333% reduction, without an equivalent salt-wedge length change. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設截面均勻且向陸流量20m³/s、鹽質量濃度15kg/m³，向陸鹽通量QC=300kg/s；實際分層需積分uC。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform landward flow20m³/s and salt concentration15kg/m³. Landward flux QC=300kg/s; stratified flow requires section integration of uC.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設固定V=1000000m³、箱內C=2kg/m³，入出流各100m³/s、入流C=5，庫存2000000kg，瞬時dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s)。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume fixed volume1000000m³,box concentration2kg/m³,equal flows100m³/s and input5kg/m³. Storage=2000000kg; instantaneous dC/dt=0.0003kg/(m³·s).

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設完全混合固定V=1000000m³、淡水Q=100m³/s、無再入鹽，C由5降1kg/m³，t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a fixed mixed box1000000m³,fresh inflow100m³/s and no renewed salt input. Falling5to1kg/m³ takes t=(V/Q)ln5=16094.4s=4.471h.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Δρ=20、參考ρ=1000kg/m³，g′=0.1962m/s²；兩層厚4與6m，c=√[g′h1h2/(h1+h2)]=0.6862m/s。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume density contrast20kg/m³,reference1000kg/m³,g′=0.1962m/s² and layers4and6m. Rigid-lid long-wave speed c=0.6862m/s.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設g′=0.1962m/s²、層尺度H=2m、速度差ΔU=0.50m/s，Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696；非局部穩定門檻。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume g′=0.1962m/s²,layer scale2m and velocity difference0.50m/s. Bulk Rib=g′H/(ΔU)²=1.5696, not a local stability threshold.
